check_name_in_common_names: check if a given name exists in the common_names set from common_names.py
filter_names_against_common_names: filter a list of candidate names against the common_names set to find matches
validate_generated_text_names: validate that names in generated text are from the common_names set to avoid hallucination
load_common_names_set: import and load the common_names set for use in name filtering or validation logic
count_common_names: count the total number of entries in the common_names set for analysis or reporting
